query_plan.query: Which country in South America has the highest GDP per capita?

steps.merge_task: Deduplicate and return the continent id and continent name for South America
steps.query: Return the continent id and continent name for South America

dependencies.dependency: Continent id and continent name of South America

steps.merge_task: Deduplicated by country and return the country with the highest GDP per capita in South America
steps.query: Return the country with their according GDP per capita for given South America id, with their country name.

extra.sql_query: SELECT countries.name FROM countries INNER JOIN continents ON continents.continent = countries.continent WHERE continents.name = 'South America' AND countries.gdp_usd / countries.population = ( SELECT MAX(countries.gdp_usd / countries.population) FROM countries INNER JOIN continents ON continents.continent = countries.continent WHERE continents.name = 'South America' AND countries.population > 0 )

s1.sql_query: SELECT continents.continent, continents.name FROM continents WHERE continents.name = 'South America'

s2.sql_query: SELECT countries.country, countries.gdp_usd, countries.population, countries.name FROM countries WHERE countries.continent = 18
